decisions.1: Q1 asks how long memory persists; no claim to directly measure a warm/hot lag ratio or universal factor of ten from a single MRS epoch.
decisions.2: 0.014 dex is absent from current draft. Historical forecast estimated independent-error standard error of the sign-corrected sample mean, sqrt(sum(sigma_i^2))/N, not an individual-source flux error. Current flux/contrast estimates explicitly defined as conditional 1-sigma; contrasts use natural logarithms.
decisions.3: Q2 emphasizes replenishment after fading, with rising sources as comparison. No claim that rises always move the boundary or Mrk 590 is the sole reformation measurement.
decisions.4: Added Elitzur & Shlosman 2006 as reference 41; dusty wind motivates evolving dust supply, without asserting wind identification or a predicted transient recovery clock. Added model-dependent CLAGN implications.
decisions.5: Synthetic observed-frame W3/W4 photometry uses WISE convention; constant host cancels only for matched spatial contributions. WISE constrains extended mid-IR light; optical/2MASS guide stellar morphology. Explicit aperture and calibration uncertainties.
decisions.6: No sample revision; 24 targets and 67.0 hours retained. UGC 03601 is R09. Proposed net-change and W3-S/N cuts are not silently applied; full histories remain central. Exact reported 2008 IRS observation has not been independently verified.
